note: DEV-ONLY proxy constants for the per-round loop. BAKED here (root:root 0600, unreadable by the solver's dropped uid) and read from THIS FILE ONLY, never from the environment. Contains NO calibrated anchor (baseline_bpb), NO ref_speedup and NO held-out corpus: the per-round signal is an ABSOLUTE public-proxy val_bpb on the PUBLIC /data/datasets/wikitext_bpe8k val split, never normalised against the graded anchor. The graded score is produced after the session by the runner from a freshly-uploaded /tests over the HIDDEN test split at the FULL wall-clock budget; this loop only decides WHICH snapshot is graded.
dev_wallclock_note: the per-round proxy trains the candidate recipe for a SHORT dev wall-clock (90 s vs the graded 600 s) so a per-round pass is minutes, not the full run. 🔴 UNLIKE the token-budgeted a4 sibling, a3's budget is WALL-CLOCK, so this dev val_bpb depends on BOTH the recipe AND this node's speed and is only a COARSE direction signal — a more sample/throughput-efficient recipe should reach a lower val_bpb in the short dev budget, but the absolute number is not node-portable and is NOT the graded score.
dev_seed_note: a FIXED dev seed distinct from every graded seed (1337/2027/90101) so the proxy cannot be seed-matched to the grade.
dev_param_note: the SAME total-parameter capacity FLOOR the graded scorer re-counts (weight-tie deduplicated). Enforced in the per-round self-check so the public proxy does not coach the solver toward a sub-floor model the grade would reject.
dev_uid_note: the candidate's per-round proxy training runs as uid 65534 (nobody), NOT root — the SAME privilege drop the graded path uses, for fidelity and to keep the loop engine from being turned into a root-training oracle. Set to null to disable (NOT recommended). The child reports the euid it actually ran under.
